Mortality in CDC bottles treated with permethrin alone was 100 % with the Kisumu strain but only 32 % with the Cové population (Fig. 5).

Pre-exposure of the Cové population to PBO resulted in a significant increase in mortality to 50 % (P < 0.05), suggesting at least some involvement of P450 detoxification enzymes in permethrin resistance in this vector population.
